//: Attach-only, and it no longer implies the emulators: as of Aug 25 2026 :3000 is normally `npm run dev` against the real project. `next dev` refuses a second server for the same directory, so this entry just points the preview at whatever is already there — read the server's env before assuming which, `ps eww <pid> | tr ' ' '\n' | grep NEXT_PUBLIC_USE_EMULATORS`.
//website-dev: The default now: `next dev` against the real Firestore, Auth and Storage. It owns the process, so do not leave it and a terminal server both in play — `next dev` refuses a second server for the same directory. Sign-in here is the real Microsoft popup, and `/api/*` (bulletin, live, Square) has nothing to reach unless the Functions emulator is running.
//website-emulated-3100: A second server against the emulators on :3100, with its own dist dir, so it coexists with whatever is already on :3000. Needs the emulator suite running (`npm run emulators`, then `npm run seed:emulator`); it is the way to try a destructive action without doing it to the parish, and the way to hold a signed-in role without the Microsoft popup.
//website-emulated-3200: Same as -3100, one port along. Peer sessions edit this tree at the same time and :3100 is often already taken; this is the spare rather than a reason to stop somebody else's server.
//website-emulated-3900: A third emulated server, on :3900. Both :3100 and :3200 were held by peer sessions on Aug 30 and the emulated backend is not interchangeable with the real one — it is the only way to be signed in with a role and a program grant without the parish Entra directory.
//website-real-3300: The real project on :3300. The default `website-dev` entry owns :3000, which a peer session usually already has; this is the spare that needs no emulator suite.
//website-real-3400: The real project on :3400, one port past website-real-3300. All of :3000, :3100 and :3300 were held by peer sessions at once; this is the next spare.
//website-real-3500: One port past that again. :3400 was taken too, on Aug 27.
//website-real-3600: One port past 3500. Peer sessions held 3000, 3300 and 3500 at once on Aug 27; this is the next spare.
//website-real-3700: One port past 3600. Every port from :3000 to :3600 was held by a peer session on Aug 28; this is the next spare against the real project.
//website-real-3800: One port past 3700. On Aug 29 peer sessions held :3000 and :3300 through :3700 at once.
//website-emulated-3250: A fifth server against the emulators, on :3250. :3100, :3200 and :3900 were all held by peer sessions on Aug 31. Not :4000 — that is the Firebase emulator UI, and taking it hides the data browser these servers exist to be checked against.
